---------------

How often have you had an opportunity to be at ground zero of a disruptive, fast-growing, and revolutionary global Amazon service? How frequently do you get to start from the foundation and solve customer needs at a global scale in a fast-growing entertainment streaming industry? At Prime Video, we are pioneering a new generation of digital supply chain at a remarkable speed to accelerate our market position and global reach. Prime Video is a global premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic and global environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. The Partner Operations Management (POM) team is looking for a bright, partner-obsessed, driven, and creative individual to join our team in India. POM is responsible for driving a world-class partner experience through enabling partners to deliver assets of all varieties on-time, in full and at the Prime Video quality bar.  
  
As a Sr. Partner Operations Manager, you will serve as the primary relationship owner for our third-party studios, content distributors, and fulfillment vendors (collectively "partners") in India. You will build and nurture long-term, strategic partnerships — engaging studio executives to influence their supply chain investments, delivery workflows, and feature adoption strategies. You will be the voice of the partner within Prime Video, capturing partner-specific insights and regional nuance to ensure our partners succeed and our customers benefit.  
  
In this role, you will own the end-to-end partner experience — from driving timely and cost-effective delivery of source materials to identifying improvement opportunities through reporting, data analysis, and innovative workflow enhancements. You will conduct regular partner business reviews, manage complex escalations, and tailor strategies to individual partner contexts across India's diverse content landscape (including SVOD, AVOD, TVOD,Channels, and partner direct business lines). The ability to develop, own, and report on key performance metrics is critical.  
This role will work with executive-level leadership within the streaming community. Internal teams include content acquisition, marketing, engineering, content processing, legal, finance, and accounting teams. External teams vary based on partner and may include marketing, rights management, IT, engineering, localization, compliance, and digital operations teams.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned studio partners in India, building trusted executive-level relationships that influence partner investments in delivery capabilities and content quality
* Conduct trend analysis and deep dives on partner performance against KPI targets to drive perfect delivery to Prime Video
* Act as the voice of the partner — capturing partner-specific feedback, regional nuances, and operational realities to advocate for solutions that enable partner success
* Own and lead regular partner business reviews (WBRs,MBRs, QBRs), translating performance data into actionable strategies tailored to each partner's context

* Drive partner adoption of delivery best practices and new platform capabilities by tailoring strategies to individual partner needs and technical maturity
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, product development, and cost reduction through data analysis and direct partner engagement
* Drive long-term solutions through next-gen automation and AI innovations to complex workflows
* Mentor team members and help develop talent across the organization

  
A day in the life  

* Engage directly with studio partner executives to understand their priorities, address delivery challenges, and align on strategic goals
* Lead partner performance reviews, using data-driven insights combined with partner context to identify root causes and drive improvements
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure partner feedback is heard and acted upon, influencing how Prime Video builds and evolves its tools and features
* Design workflow strategies for accelerated content delivery in multiple languages and formats across India's diverse content ecosystem, while simplifying and eliminating redundant practices
* Streamline business and technology solutions that strengthen our partnerships while advancing our services
* Work effectively in a team environment and cross-functionally with Prime Video Catalog technology teams, engineers, business teams, analytics, and product

* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an **experienced E-commerce Operations professional to manage day-to-day marketplace operations on Amazon and Flipkart.** The candidate should have strong knowledge of order processing, returns and RTO management, seller claims, settlements, reconciliation, and operational issue resolution.

The primary responsibility will be to ensure smooth marketplace operations, minimize return-related losses, recover eligible claims, maintain account health, and ensure accurate financial settlements.

Roles and Responsibilities

1. Order and Marketplace Operations

- Monitor daily orders, order processing, dispatches, cancellations, and delivery status across Amazon and Flipkart.

- Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, and internal teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.

- Track pending orders, delayed dispatches, delivery failures, and operational escalations.

- Monitor marketplace dashboards and resolve operational issues within defined timelines.

- Ensure compliance with Amazon and Flipkart seller policies and operational requirements.

### 2. Returns, RTO and Refund Management

- Monitor customer returns, Return to Origin (RTO), refund cases, and return-related losses on both platforms.

- Analyze return reasons, including damaged products, defective items, wrong products, missing parts, and customer-related issues.

- Verify returned products and coordinate with the warehouse team for physical inspection and documentation.

- Identify cases where the product returned is damaged, used, incomplete, incorrect, or different from the originally dispatched product.

- Raise eligible claims and disputes with Amazon and Flipkart within the prescribed timelines.

- Track return claims, reimbursements, refunds, and claim rejection reasons until closure.

- Maintain a record of high-return SKUs and identify corrective actions to reduce return rates.

- Investigate recurring RTO and return issues and recommend preventive measures.

### 3. Claims, Reimbursements and Loss Recovery

- Raise and follow up on eligible claims for lost shipments, damaged returns, missing products, incorrect returns, and other recoverable marketplace losses.

- Track claim submission dates, claim IDs, supporting evidence, approval status, rejected claims, and reimbursements received.

- Review marketplace policies to ensure claims are filed correctly and within deadlines.

- Escalate unresolved claims to the relevant marketplace support teams and account managers.

- Maintain a claim recovery tracker showing the amount claimed, approved, rejected, recovered, and pending.

- Identify missed claims and prevent revenue leakage due to delayed or incorrect claim submissions.

### 4. Settlement and Financial Reconciliation

- Reconcile marketplace settlements against orders, invoices, refunds, returns, commissions, shipping fees, penalties, and other deductions.

- Identify settlement discrepancies, incorrect charges, unexpected deductions, and missing reimbursements.

- Coordinate with the finance team to resolve payment and reconciliation issues.

- Maintain SKU-wise and order-wise records of operational losses and recoveries.

- Prepare reports on return losses, RTO costs, claim recoveries, and outstanding settlement discrepancies.

### 5. Marketplace Account Health

- Monitor account health, policy violations, operational performance, and marketplace notifications.

- Ensure timely resolution of seller support cases and account-related escalations.

- Maintain proper records of all support tickets, emails, claims, and resolutions.

- Stay updated on changes to Amazon and Flipkart return, reimbursement, and seller-operation policies.

### 6. Reporting and Analysis

- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering:

- Orders processed and pending

- Customer returns and RTO

- Return and cancellation rates

- Return reasons by SKU

- Claims raised, approved, rejected, and pending

- Reimbursements recovered

- Settlement discrepancies

- Total return-related financial losses

- Analyze operational data to identify recurring problems and high-loss products.

- Share actionable recommendations with management to reduce losses and improve operational efficiency.

## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against the following:

1. Reduction in avoidable return and RTO losses.

2. Percentage of eligible claims submitted within marketplace deadlines.

3. Claim recovery rate and value of reimbursements recovered.

4. Reduction in unresolved claims and ageing support tickets.

5. Timely completion of settlement reconciliation.

6. Accuracy of operational reports and claim documentation.

7. Resolution time for marketplace operational issues.

8. Reduction in repeat return issues through root-cause analysis.

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 2–5 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce marketplace operations.

- Practical working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.

- Strong understanding of returns, RTO, refunds, reimbursements, and marketplace claims.

- Experience in settlement reconciliation and identifying financial discrepancies.

- Good knowledge of Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, and reporting.

- Strong analytical, communication, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to coordinate with warehouse, logistics, finance, and marketplace account managers.

- High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be someone who does not simply process orders but actively investigates operational losses, follows up on pending claims, recovers eligible amounts from marketplaces, and ensures that every return, deduction, and reimbursement is properly tracked.

\*Primary objective:\* To ensure efficient Amazon and Flipkart operations while reducing return-related losses, improving claim recovery, and maintaining accurate marketplace settlements.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable  

Amazon Financial Operations \| Level 5 \| Full\-Time \| US Shift  

  

Every payment Amazon makes to a supplier starts with a promise \- and the Accounts Payable Operations team is the engine that keeps that promise, at massive scale, across dozens of subsidiaries and global marketplaces. As a FinOps Manager – AP, you’ll lead a core US\-shift team responsible for the full invoice lifecycle \- from ingestion through successful payment execution \- ensuring that tens of thousands of vendors worldwide are paid accurately and on time.  

  

This is a high\-visibility leadership role at the intersection of operational excellence and financial transformation. You’ll own the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into a centralized operating model, build the playbooks that scale our operations for Amazon’s continued expansion, and drive automation initiatives that directly reduce manual touchpoints and cost\-per\-transaction. If you’re energized by building teams, simplifying complexity, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast\-moving environment \- this role was made for you.  

  

Role Overview  

  

The FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable will lead a team supporting core US\-shift AP operations and play a critical role in ensuring financial operations are scalable, efficient, and prepared for continued business growth.  

  

The role will have end\-to\-end ownership of the Accounts Payable process, from invoice ingestion through invoice processing, exception/hold resolution, and successful payment execution. Basic Qualifications  

  

1\. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 10\+ years of post\-qualification experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or a related field.

r against challenging goals.

6\. Experience working with automation, workflow, self\-service, or finance technology solutions.  

  

7\. Experience developing operational metrics and using data to drive business decisions.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Lead, manage, and develop a team of AP Specialists and Operations Managers supporting end\-to\-end Accounts Payable operations.  

  

2\. Own day\-to\-day operational performance and ensure accuracy, timeliness, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.  

  

3\. Successfully lead the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into the operations team, ensuring smooth migration, stabilization, and business continuity.  

  

4\. Manage hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and career development for team members.  

  

5\. Establish team priorities, allocate workload effectively, and ensure appropriate resource planning based on business requirements and volume forecasts.  

  

6\. Drive systems, process, and operational improvements to enable on\-time and accurate vendor payments.

11\. Develop, maintain, and monitor operational metrics and dashboards covering SLA performance, payment timeliness, productivity, quality, defects, backlog, cost, and customer/vendor experience.  

  

12\. Drive cost optimization initiatives and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and scalability.  

  

13\. Partner with Finance leadership to forecast future headcount requirements based on business growth, transaction volumes, country expansion, and operational demand.  

  

14\. Expand self\-service capabilities and digital solutions to improve the vendor experience while reducing manual intervention.  

  

15\. Provide regular weekly and monthly business reviews, performance updates, and operational insights to Director\- and VP\-level Finance stakeholders.  

  

16\. Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls across AP processes.  

  

17\. Partner with Internal Audit, controllership, compliance, and finance teams to address control gaps and audit requirements.  

  

18\. Lead cross\-functional technology, systems, and process\-improvement initiatives involving Finance, Procurement, Operations, and technical teams.

b) Identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and recurring defects.  

c) Performing root\-cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.

About the team  

About the Team  

  

Accounts Payable Operations supports multiple geographies and marketplaces globally and provides critical financial services across the organization.

2\. Invoice ingestion and validation.

* 4\+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
